entries.text: I have lived with a fragile faith, built on the ether of vague memories, from an experience that I could neither prove nor explain. When I was 12, my sister was taken from me. Taken from our home by a force that I came to believe was extraterrestrial. This belief sustained me, fueling a quest for truths that were as elusive as the memory itself. To believe as passionately as I did was not without sacrifice, but I always accepted the risks-- to my career, my reputation, my relationships-- to life itself.

entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Our "friend" from the c.I.a. Is about as unbelievable as his story, as is everything about this case. Whatever happened to "trust no one," Mulder?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I changed it to "trust everyone." I didn't tell you? I ran a full background check on this guy. Ambrose Chapel is a 17-year veteran. Special intelligence clearance. He's the real thing, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Why would a man with his experience need our help? And how could he let a man he's been looking so hard for... Slip away so easily? That doctor wasn't running away from us, Mulder. He was running away from agent chapel.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I think you're being overly paranoid about him, Scully.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Paranoid. Have you stopped to consider... That maybe it was chapel who killed that agent in Syracuse?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Is that what you want me to put on my report? I'd be happy to have you explain that to him.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Damn it, Mulder, that is not my job. You'll pursue a case... At the expense of everything, to the point of insanity, and expect me to follow you. There has to be somewhere to draw the line.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Three identical men are dead. A fourth identical man is alive and on the lam. If the pursuit of this case seems like insanity to you, step away from it.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: An FBI agent died because of our pursuit of this case.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Those are the risks we take. You either accept them or you don't. We all draw our own lines.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I have to show you something. I got these a week ago. I stepped in something last night that ate clean through the sole. Now, maybe I'm being paranoid, but it was in the exact spot where this man chapel said the doctor escaped.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Why don't you send it to our lab guys for analysis? While you're at it, why don't you arrange for an autopsy bay?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: An autopsy bay?
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Putting together my report for Skinner, I came across something I think you'll appreciate. Whoever killed that field agent in Syracuse was so clever... No clear cause of death can be established.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: X-FILES OFFICE · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: There's no penetrating knife or gunshot wounds; no ligature marks or abrasions from strangulation; the toxicological is clean; and the blood work-- well, the blood work is strange.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Strange how?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Well, there's evidence of polycythemia-- excessive production of red blood cells.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: How excessive?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Extremely. The doctor who made this report has it that the blood was "curdled like jelly." as if something caused the blood to thicken or clot prior to death.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Due to what?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Possibly a coagulating agent... Introduced into the body, but it would have shown up on the toxicological.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Didn't agent chapel say something about these doctors... Being able to contaminate the blood supply? Couldn't one of those contaminants have been used to kill this man?
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I don't know, Mulder. I-- there was a doctor's bag I took as evidence from the apartment.
entries.speaker: Dana Scully
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: Agent Mulder? Assistant director Skinner's been looking for you.

entries.text: Just the truth. I got hit by a car.
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder
entries.location: AUTOPSY BAY · FBI HEADQUARTERS · WASHINGTON, D.C.

entries.text: I'm sorry this is so late. I had trouble with the data--
entries.speaker: Fox Mulder

entries.text: That's not why I called you in here, agent Mulder. Your father's been trying to reach you. There's been a family emergency.
